KNOW BEFORE YOU GO

A map with receipts.

This directory is incomplete. The number of missing current restaurants is unknown. A listing, a mapped building or a checked webpage does not confirm that a business is operating today.

Closed historical places are hidden by default. Temporary closures and unresolved listings remain clearly marked. Open-now and open-late use published weekly hours in America/New_York; holiday changes and current kitchen availability are not confirmed.

Quick filters use explicit menu, cuisine or official-site evidence. Date night is an editorial selection based on the linked venue's dining and drinks offering, not a customer rating. Open late means published hours reach 10 pm or later today. Unknown fields are excluded when their filter is active.

Ratings retain their provider and capture date. Google Maps, Yelp and Tripadvisor search links are lookup shortcuts, not verified profiles or a complete provider census.

The dashed city outline comes from Nashua GIS. All stored pins passed a geographic boundary check; shared-site and approximate storefront locations are labeled individually.

Favorites stay in this browser on this device. Venue photos are externally hosted and credited; unavailable photos use a clearly labeled placeholder.
